<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>依从性报告</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://api.map.baidu.com/api?v=3.0&ak=6zXfgKZZiCdrL3MZBH7DGpjemq5IRxRC"></script>
<style>
  :root {
    --app-bg-top: #f7fbff;
    --app-bg-bottom: #edf4ff;
    --app-ink: #0f172a;
    --app-muted: #64748b;
    --app-line: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.24);
    --app-card-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(15,23,42,.08), 0 3px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    --app-card-shadow-strong: 0 22px 46px rgba(15,23,42,.12), 0 10px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
    --app-icon-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(148,163,184,.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -10px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
  }
  body {
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;
    text-size-adjust:100%;
    color: var(--app-ink);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(96,165,250,.18), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(52,211,153,.16), transparent 24%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--app-bg-top) 0%, var(--app-bg-bottom) 100%);
    min-height:100vh;
    position:relative;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  body::before {
    content:"";
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.22), transparent 36%),
      repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 18px);
    pointer-events:none;
    opacity:.65;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .app-shell {
    position:relative;
    isolation:isolate;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    padding-bottom:calc(128px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }
  .app-shell::before {
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:14px 12px auto;
    height:120px;
    border-radius:28px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.95), rgba(255,255,255,.35));
    box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(148,163,184,.18);
    filter:blur(8px);
    z-index:-1;
  }
  .app-header {
    margin:0 10px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);
    border-top:none;
    border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(248,250,252,.82));
    backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.3);
    box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.09), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .status-pill {
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(251,191,36,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65);
  }
  .condition-chip {
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    transform:translateY(0);
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .context-chip {
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:6px 10px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#334155;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(203,213,225,.95);
    box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(148,163,184,.12);
  }
  .condition-chip:hover {
    transform:translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  }
  .ai-panel {
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.94), rgba(248,250,252,.88));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
  }
  .top-overview-panel {
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(239,246,255,.96), rgba(248,250,252,.92));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
  }
  .ai-panel-kicker {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, #ddeafe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .top-overview-kicker {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #dbeafe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .hero-welcome-card {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(110px,.9fr);
    gap:14px;
    padding:18px;
    border-radius:30px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(129,140,248,.18), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%, rgba(243,244,255,.96) 48%, rgba(237,233,254,.94) 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow-strong);
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero-welcome-card::after {
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:auto -30px -35px auto;
    width:170px;
    height:170px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,.18) 0%, transparent 72%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-welcome-eyebrow { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; color:#7c3aed; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .hero-welcome-title { font-size:1.58rem; line-height:1.2; font-weight:900; color:#111827; margin:0 0 10px; letter-spacing:-.02em; }
  .hero-welcome-summary { font-size:.94rem; line-height:1.65; color:#334155; margin:0 0 12px; }
  .hero-welcome-note {
    font-size:.9rem;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:#312e81;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.55);
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.08);
  }
  .hero-welcome-meta { margin-top:12px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; color:#64748b; }
  .hero-welcome-visual {
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:flex-end;
    justify-content:space-between;
    position:relative;
    min-height:172px;
  }
  .hero-avatar-badge {
    width:68px;
    height:68px;
    border-radius:22px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1.4rem;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#334155;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #e0f2fe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .hero-assistant-orb {
    width:96px;
    height:96px;
    border-radius:30px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:2.4rem;
    color:#4f46e5;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.95), rgba(224,231,255,.96));
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
    box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(99,102,241,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .quick-nav-strip {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap:10px;
    padding:0 12px;
  }
  .quick-nav-btn {
    border:none;
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:12px 10px;
    text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.96), rgba(239,246,255,.92));
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .quick-nav-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 16px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.09); }
  .quick-nav-btn.active { border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.42); background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(243,244,255,.98), rgba(237,233,254,.92)); }
  .quick-nav-icon { font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1; }
  .quick-nav-title { margin-top:6px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .quick-nav-copy { margin-top:2px; font-size:.68rem; line-height:1.4; color:#64748b; }
  .status-overview-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(248,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .status-overview-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; }
  .status-overview-label { font-size:.92rem; color:#0f172a; font-weight:800; }
  .status-overview-score { margin-top:6px; font-size:3rem; line-height:1; font-weight:900; color:#111827; letter-spacing:-.04em; }
  .status-overview-score span { font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; color:#94a3b8; margin-left:4px; }
  .status-overview-caption { margin-top:8px; font-size:.86rem; font-weight:800; }
  .status-overview-ring {
    position:relative;
    width:88px;
    height:88px;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:8px;
    background:conic-gradient(from 180deg, rgba(124,58,237,.2), rgba(139,92,246,.92), rgba(59,130,246,.78));
    box-shadow:0 20px 32px rgba(99,102,241,.18);
  }
  .status-overview-ring-fill { width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:999px; opacity:.92; }
  .status-overview-ring-text {
    position:absolute;
    inset:15px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1.1rem;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#1f2937;
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  }
  .status-overview-progress { margin-top:14px; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:#ede9fe; overflow:hidden; }
  .status-overview-progress-bar { height:100%; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 55%, #4f46e5 100%); }
  .status-overview-foot { margin-top:12px; font-size:.84rem; line-height:1.65; color:#475569; }
  .dashboard-panel {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(247,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .dashboard-panel-head { margin-bottom:12px; }
  .dashboard-panel-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .dashboard-panel-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.8rem; color:#64748b; line-height:1.5; }
  .dashboard-metric-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .dashboard-metric-card {
    border-radius:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    padding:14px;
    min-height:132px;
  }
  .dashboard-metric-icon { font-size:1.35rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .dashboard-metric-title { font-size:.78rem; font-weight:800; color:#64748b; }
  .dashboard-metric-value { margin-top:6px; font-size:1.28rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; line-height:1.15; }
  .dashboard-metric-note { margin-top:7px; font-size:.75rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .dashboard-progress-card {
    margin-top:14px;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245,243,255,.96), rgba(255,255,255,.95));
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.55);
    padding:14px 15px;
  }
  .dashboard-progress-title { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:850; color:#6d28d9; }
  .dashboard-progress-copy { margin-top:6px; font-size:.84rem; line-height:1.65; color:#475569; }
  .nutrition-spotlight-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(16,185,129,.12), transparent 28%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(244,253,250,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .nutrition-spotlight-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .nutrition-spotlight-title { font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .nutrition-spotlight-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .nutrition-spotlight-badge {
    padding:8px 10px;
    border-radius:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #dcfce7 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(187,247,208,.95);
    font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#047857;
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(16,185,129,.12);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .nutrition-ring-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; }
  .nutrition-ring-card {
    border-radius:20px;
    padding:12px 10px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #f8fffc 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(220,252,231,.92);
    text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
  }
  .nutrition-ring {
    --ring-accent:#10b981;
    --ring-track:#d1fae5;
    width:72px;
    height:72px;
    margin:0 auto 8px;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:7px;
    background:conic-gradient(var(--ring-accent) 0 calc(var(--pct) * 1%), var(--ring-track) calc(var(--pct) * 1%) 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
  }
  .nutrition-ring-inner {
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:.9rem;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#0f172a;
  }
  .nutrition-ring-label { font-size:.75rem; font-weight:800; color:#0f172a; }
  .nutrition-ring-note { margin-top:3px; font-size:.68rem; line-height:1.35; color:#64748b; }
  .nutrition-story {
    margin-top:14px;
    padding:14px 15px;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236,253,245,.96), rgba(255,255,255,.95));
    border:1px solid rgba(167,243,208,.76);
    font-size:.86rem;
    line-height:1.75;
    color:#334155;
  }
  .trend-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(247,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .trend-card-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .trend-card-head > div { min-width:0; }
  .trend-card-title { font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .trend-card-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-range-tabs {
    display:inline-grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap:6px;
    padding:5px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#f1f5f9;
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
  }
  .trend-range-btn {
    border:none;
    background:transparent;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:8px 12px;
    font-size:.75rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#64748b;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:all .18s ease;
  }
  .trend-range-btn.active {
    color:#6d28d9;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #ede9fe 100%);
    box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(99,102,241,.12);
  }
  .trend-insight-chip {
    padding:8px 10px;
    border-radius:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(191,219,254,.95);
    font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#2563eb;
    white-space:normal;
    line-height:1.45;
    max-width:100%;
  }
  .trend-metric-stack { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:12px; }
  .trend-metric-card {
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:14px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #fbfdff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
  }
  .trend-metric-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; }
  .trend-metric-kicker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .trend-metric-icon {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1rem;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .trend-metric-label { font-size:.8rem; font-weight:800; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-metric-value { margin-top:3px; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .trend-metric-delta { font-size:.75rem; font-weight:800; }
  .trend-metric-copy { margin-top:8px; font-size:.76rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-chart { width:100%; height:76px; margin-top:10px; display:block; }
  .trend-axis { margin-top:6px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:.68rem; color:#94a3b8; }
  .priority-plan-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(249,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .priority-plan-head { margin-bottom:14px; }
  .priority-plan-title { font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .priority-plan-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .priority-task-card {
    border-radius:22px;
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #fbfcff 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    padding:14px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  .priority-task-main { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; }
  .priority-task-index {
    width:32px;
    height:32px;
    border-radius:999px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:.9rem;
    font-weight:900;
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.24);
  }
  .priority-task-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1.45; color:#111827; }
  .priority-task-reason { margin-top:8px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.6; color:#f97316; font-weight:700; }
  .priority-task-emoji { font-size:2.1rem; line-height:1; filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(148,163,184,.16)); }
  .priority-task-actions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:8px; margin-top:12px; }
  .priority-task-btn {
    border:none;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:10px 12px;
    font-size:.78rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.18);
    transition:background .18s ease, color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .priority-task-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); }
  .priority-task-btn.active {
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981 0%, #059669 100%);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(16,185,129,.14), 0 12px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.18);
  }
  .priority-task-btn.secondary {
    color:#6b7280;
    background:#f8fafc;
    border:1px solid #e2e8f0;
    box-shadow:none;
  }
  .priority-task-btn.secondary.active {
    color:#fff;
    background:#64748b;
    border-color:#64748b;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(100,116,139,.14);
  }
  .priority-special-note {
    margin-top:8px;
    border-radius:18px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(237,233,254,.92), rgba(248,250,255,.95));
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.62);
    padding:12px 14px;
    font-size:.84rem;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:#4338ca;
  }
  .priority-special-label { display:block; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:850; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .meal-card { transition: all .2s; }
  .meal-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.1); }
  .feedback-actions { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; align-self:stretch; }
  .feedback-btn {
    opacity:1;
    cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid #d8dee8;
    background:#fff;
    color:#475569;
    font-size:.76rem;
    line-height:1.1;
    padding:8px 11px;
    border-radius:999px;
    min-height:36px;
    min-width:92px;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:6px;
    font-weight:750;

<script>
(function() {
  var bmap = new BMap.Map("bmap");
  bmap.enableScrollWheelZoom(true);
  var userPoint = new BMap.Point(-71.8079906, 42.2766632);
  var mapMode = 'hospital';
  var mapMarkers = [];
  var mapCards = [];
  var mapRoute = null;
  var userOverlays = [];
  var AI_MAP_TEXT = { hospital: "您近期活动量偏低，天气不错时可以去附近公园散散步。", park: "您近期活动量偏低，天气不错时可以去附近公园散散步。" };

  document.getElementById('locate-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (userPoint) { bmap.panTo(userPoint); bmap.setZoom(15); }
  });

  var USER_ICON_SVG = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28">'
    + '<circle cx="14" cy="14" r="13" fill="#4285f4" fill-opacity="0.2" stroke="#4285f4" stroke-width="1"/>'
    + '<circle cx="14" cy="14" r="7" fill="#4285f4" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5"/>'
    + '</svg>';
  var USER_ICON = new BMap.Icon(
    'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(USER_ICON_SVG),
    new BMap.Size(28, 28),
    { anchor: new BMap.Size(14, 14) }
  );

  function addUserOverlays() {
    userOverlays.forEach(function(o) { bmap.removeOverlay(o); });
    userOverlays = [];
    var marker = new BMap.Marker(userPoint, { icon: USER_ICON });
    bmap.addOverlay(marker);
    userOverlays.push(marker);
    var label = new BMap.Label('\u60a8\u5728\u8fd9\u91cc', {
      position: userPoint,
      offset: new BMap.Size(16, -8)
    });
    label.setStyle({
      background:'#4285f4',color:'#fff',border:'none',
      borderRadius:'6px',padding:'2px 8px',
      fontSize:'12px',fontWeight:'600',
      boxShadow:'0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',whiteSpace:'nowrap'
    });
    bmap.addOverlay(label);
    userOverlays.push(label);
  }

  function clearRoute() {
    if (mapRoute) { mapRoute.clearResults(); mapRoute = null; }
  }
  function clearResultMarkers() {
    clearRoute();
    mapMarkers.forEach(function(m) { bmap.removeOverlay(m); });
    mapMarkers = [];
    mapCards = [];
  }

  bmap.centerAndZoom(userPoint, 15);
  addUserOverlays();
  doMapSearch('hospital');

  window.switchMapMode = function(mode) {
    if (mode === mapMode) return;
    mapMode = mode;
    document.getElementById('btn-hospital').className = mode === 'hospital' ? 'active' : '';
    document.getElementById('btn-park').className = mode === 'park' ? 'active park-mode' : '';
    document.getElementById('ai-map-text').textContent = AI_MAP_TEXT[mode];
    clearResultMarkers();
    document.getElementById('map-cards').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#bbb;padding:16px;font-size:0.85em">\u641c\u7d22\u4e2d\u2026</div>';
    doMapSearch(mode);
  };

  function doMapSearch(mode) {
    if (!userPoint) return;
    var keyword = mode === 'hospital' ? '\u533b\u9662' : '\u516c\u56ed';
    var local = new BMap.LocalSearch(bmap, {
      renderOptions: { autoViewport: false },
      onSearchComplete: function(results) {
        clearResultMarkers();
        var container = document.getElementById('map-cards');
        container.innerHTML = '';
        if (!results || local.getStatus() !== BMAP_STATUS_SUCCESS || results.getCurrentNumPois() === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#bbb;padding:16px;font-size:0.85em">\u9644\u8fd1\u6682\u65e0\u76f8\u5173\u5730\u70b9</div>';
          return;
        }
        var count = results.getCurrentNumPois();
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          (function(idx) {
            var poi = results.getPoi(idx);
            var dist = bmap.getDistance(userPoint, poi.point);
            var distText = dist >= 1000 ? (dist/1000).toFixed(1)+' km' : Math.round(dist)+' m';
            var marker = new BMap.Marker(poi.point);
            bmap.addOverlay(marker);
            mapMarkers.push(marker);
            marker.addEventListener('click', function() { focusMapCard(idx, poi); });
            var card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'map-place';
            card.innerHTML = '<div class="map-place-icon '+mode+'">'+(mode==='hospital'?'\ud83c\udfe5':'\ud83c\udf33')+'</div>'
              +'<div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><div style="font-size:0.9em;font-weight:600;color:#222;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+poi.title+'</div>'
              +'<div style="font-size:0.75em;color:#999;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+(poi.address||'\u6682\u65e0\u5730\u5740')+'</div></div>'
              +'<div class="map-dist '+mode+'">'+distText+'</div>'
              +'<button class="map-place-nav'+(mode==='park'?' park-mode':'')+'" title="\u5bfc\u822a">\u27a4</button>';
            card.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
              if (e.target.classList.contains('map-place-nav')) return;
              focusMapCard(idx, poi);
            });
            card.querySelector('.map-place-nav').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
              e.stopPropagation();
              navigateMapTo(poi);
            });
            container.appendChild(card);
            mapCards.push(card);
          })(i);
        }
      }
    });
    local.searchNearby(keyword, userPoint, 4000);
  }

  function focusMapCard(idx, poi) {
    mapCards.forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('focused','park-mode'); });
    mapCards[idx].classList.add('focused');
    if (mapMode === 'park') mapCards[idx].classList.add('park-mode');
    mapCards[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest' });
    bmap.panTo(poi.point);
    mapMarkers[idx].openInfoWindow(
      new BMap.InfoWindow('<b>'+poi.title+'</b><br><span style="color:#888;font-size:12px">'+(poi.address||'')+'</span>')
    );
    clearRoute();
    var routeColor = mapMode === 'hospital' ? '#1e88e5' : '#43a047';
    var walking = new BMap.WalkingRoute(bmap, {
      renderOptions: { map: bmap, autoViewport: false },
      onSearchComplete: function(results) {
        if (walking.getStatus() !== BMAP_STATUS_SUCCESS) return;
        var plan = results.getPlan(0);
        for (var s = 0; s < plan.getNumRoutes(); s++) {
          var route = plan.getRoute(s);
          var path = route.getPolyline();
          if (path) { path.setStrokeColor(routeColor); path.setStrokeWeight(5); path.setStrokeOpacity(0.85); }
        }
        addUserOverlays();
      }
    });
    walking.search(userPoint, poi.point);
    mapRoute = walking;
  }

  function navigateMapTo(poi) {
    var destLat = poi.point.lat;
    var destLng = poi.point.lng;
    var destName = encodeURIComponent(poi.title);
    var isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    var appUrl = 'baidumap://map/direction?destination=latlng:'+destLat+','+destLng+'|name:'+destName+'&mode=walking&coord_type=bd09ll&src=webapp';
    var webUrl = 'https://api.map.baidu.com/marker?location='+destLat+','+destLng+'&title='+destName+'&output=html&coord_type=bd09ll&src=webapp';
    if (isMobile) {
      window.location.href = appUrl;
      setTimeout(function() { window.location.href = webUrl; }, 2000);
    } else {
      window.open(webUrl, '_blank');
    }
  }
})();

function saveFeedback(dayIdx, mealType, itemName, reason) {

}

function applyStaticButtonState(sourceEl, sentiment) {
  if (!sourceEl) return;
  const group = sourceEl.closest(".priority-task-actions, .feedback-actions");
  if (!group) return;
  group.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function(btn) {
    const isSecondary = btn.classList.contains("secondary") || btn.classList.contains("feedback-skip");
    btn.classList.remove("liked", "disliked", "active");
    if (btn.dataset.defaultLabel) btn.textContent = btn.dataset.defaultLabel;
    if (sentiment === "like" && !isSecondary) {
      if (btn.classList.contains("priority-task-btn")) btn.classList.add("active");
      else btn.classList.add("liked");
      if (btn.dataset.activeLabel) btn.textContent = btn.dataset.activeLabel;
    }
    if (sentiment === "dislike" && isSecondary) {
      if (btn.classList.contains("priority-task-btn")) btn.classList.add("active");
      else btn.classList.add("disliked");
      if (btn.dataset.activeLabel) btn.textContent = btn.dataset.activeLabel;
    }
  });
}

function clearStaticButtonState(sourceEl) {
  applyStaticButtonState(sourceEl, null);
}

function syncStaticButtonState(dayIdx, mealType, itemName) {
  const feedback = getFeedback(dayIdx, mealType, itemName);
  if (!feedback) return;
  const selector = [
    `[data-day-idx="${dayIdx}"]`,
    `[data-meal-type="${mealType}"]`,
    `[data-item-name="${itemName.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"]`
  ].join("");
  const button = document.querySelector(selector);
  if (button) applyStaticButtonState(button, feedback.sentiment);
}

function hydrateStaticFeedbackStates() {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-day-idx][data-meal-type][data-item-name]").forEach(function(btn) {
    const dayIdx = Number(btn.dataset.dayIdx);
    const mealType = btn.dataset.mealType;
    const itemName = btn.dataset.itemName;
    const feedback = getFeedback(dayIdx, mealType, itemName);
    if (feedback) applyStaticButtonState(btn, feedback.sentiment);
  });
}

function saveLike(dayIdx, mealType, itemName, sourceEl) {
  const key = `${dayIdx}-${mealType}-${itemName}`;
  const existing = feedbackStore[key];
  if (existing && existing.sentiment === "like") {
    clearFeedbackEntry(dayIdx, mealType, itemName);
    if (dayIdx < 0) clearStaticButtonState(sourceEl);
    renderMeals();
    updateExportBadge();
    return;
  }
  feedbackStore[key] = { sentiment: "like", reason: null, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
  localStorage.setItem(FEEDBACK_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(feedbackStore));
  if (dayIdx < 0) applyStaticButtonState(sourceEl, "like");
  renderMeals();
  updateExportBadge();
}

function getFeedback(dayIdx, mealType, itemName) {
  return feedbackStore[`${dayIdx}-${mealType}-${itemName}`];
}

function buildPreferencePayload() {
  const likes = [];
  const dislikes = [];
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(feedbackStore)) {
    const entry = { item_key: key, ...val };
    if (val.sentiment === "like") likes.push(entry);
    else dislikes.push(entry);
  }
  const selectedCuisines = Object.entries(cuisinePrefs).map(([name, meta]) => ({
    cuisine: name, ...meta
  }));
  return {
    user_id: "P-20260513-002",
    data_type: "scenario",
    language: "zh",
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    data: {
      bundle: {
        type: "user_preference",
        report_time: "2026年05月13日 14:00",
        total_feedback: likes.length + dislikes.length,
        cuisine_preferences: selectedCuisines,
        liked: likes,
        disliked: dislikes
      }
    }
  };
}

function exportFeedbackJSON() {
  const payload = buildPreferencePayload();
  const btn = document.getElementById("exportFeedbackBtn");
  if (!btn) return;
  const origText = btn.textContent;
  const feedbackId = "feedback_" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  pendingFeedbackSubmits[feedbackId] = { btn, origText };
  btn.textContent = "⏳ 提交中...";
  btn.disabled = true;
  window.parent.postMessage({
    type: "skill_feedback",
    feedback_id: feedbackId,
    payload
  }, "*");
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!pendingFeedbackSubmits[feedbackId]) return;
    delete pendingFeedbackSubmits[feedbackId];
    btn.textContent = origText;
    btn.disabled = false;
  }, 8000);
}

window.addEventListener("message", function(event) {
  const data = event.data || {};
  if (data.type !== "skill_feedback_result" || !data.feedback_id) return;
  const pending = pendingFeedbackSubmits[data.feedback_id];
  if (!pending) return;
  delete pendingFeedbackSubmits[data.feedback_id];
  pending.btn.textContent = data.ok === false ? "提交失败" : "✓ 已提交";
  setTimeout(() => {
    pending.btn.textContent = pending.origText;
    pending.btn.disabled = false;
  }, 2500);
});

function updateExportBadge() {
  const shell = document.getElementById("submitCtaShell");
  const btn = document.getElementById("exportFeedbackBtn");
  const hint = document.getElementById("submitHint");
  if (!btn) return;
  const fbCount = Object.keys(feedbackStore).length;
  const cuisineCount = Object.keys(cuisinePrefs).length;
  const total = fbCount + cuisineCount;
  if (shell) shell.style.display = "block";
  if (total > 0) {
    btn.textContent = "✓ 提交我的偏好 (" + total + ")";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.style.display = "inline-block";
    if (hint) {
      hint.style.display = "block";

    }

    btn.disabled = true;

    btn.style.display = "inline-block";
    if (hint) {
      hint.style.display = "block";
      hint.textContent = "请先在上面选择口味或标记适合/不适合";
    }
  }
}

function showFeedbackModal(dayIdx, mealType, itemName, sourceEl) {
  const existing = document.querySelector('.feedback-modal');
  if (existing) existing.remove();
  const isMeal = dayIdx >= 0;
  const reasons = isMeal ? MEAL_FEEDBACK_REASONS : GENERAL_FEEDBACK_REASONS;
  const title = isMeal ? "为什么不想要这个食物？" : "为什么这个建议不适合您？";

  });
  document.body.appendChild(modal);
}

function buildTrendSparkline(values, color) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || !values.length) return "";
  const width = 320;
  const height = 76;
  const pad = 6;
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const span = Math.max(max - min, 1);
  const points = values.map((val, idx) => {
    const x = pad + (idx * (width - pad * 2)) / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1);
    const y = height - pad - ((val - min) / span) * (height - pad * 2);
    return [x, y];
  });
  const line = points.map(([x, y]) => `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
  const area = `0,${height} ` + points.map(([x, y]) => `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`).join(" ") + ` ${width},${height}`;
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const gradId = "trendFill" + Math.abs(color.split("").reduce((sum, ch) => sum + ch.charCodeAt(0), 0));
  return `
    <svg class="trend-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="${gradId}" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0.22"></stop>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0"></stop>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <polyline points="${area}" fill="url(#${gradId})" stroke="none"></polyline>
      <polyline points="${line}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></polyline>
      <circle cx="${last[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${last[1].toFixed(1)}" r="4.5" fill="#fff" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2"></circle>
    </svg>`;
}

  const allCuisines = [...DEFAULT_CUISINES];

function toggleCuisine(name) {
  if (cuisinePrefs[name]) {
    delete cuisinePrefs[name];

  localStorage.setItem(CUISINE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cuisinePrefs));
  renderCuisineChips();
  showCuisineToast();
}

  existing.style.opacity = "1";
  clearTimeout(existing._timer);
  existing._timer = setTimeout(() => { existing.style.opacity = "0"; }, 3000);
}

function removeCuisine(name) {
